title: questframe
summary: MSUI has the repaired NPC QuestFrame runtime and draw contracts while retaining its protected Quest Log and present-different behavior. The shared shell, NPC panel chrome and Quest Log geometry are now rule-owned without changing presentation: QuestFrameUiLaw supplies the frame, NPC portrait aperture, log/NPC panel art tables, greeting patch, NPC name frame/text seats, mode-specific close rectangle, NPC scroll viewport/bar/track/thumb and footer actions, greeting paragraph/header/break/quest-row seats, NPC detail/progress/reward text columns and inline-money anchors, shared coin-chain seats, abandon-confirmation seats, list clip/rows/icons, count pill text, collapse/track controls, bottom buttons, detail scrollbar UV/thumb projection, detail clip/scrolled text column, reward grids, reward-item icon/name/count/hit/highlight seats, money and reward-spell seats. NPC reward-item tooltips now use the authored ANCHOR_RIGHT seat; the protected Quest Log tooltip presentation is intentionally unchanged. Existing connected NPC/item-giver, physical input/audio, rendered-capture and user-visible verification debt remains open.

openItems.text: QuestNpcNameText explicitly inherits white GameFontHighlight, but the NPC dialogue renderer and its parity trace used the shared gold GameFontNormal title path.
openItems.resolution: QuestFrameUiLaw now owns the NPC name font; NPC detail/greeting/progress/reward panels and their trace consume GameFontHighlight at the existing exact seat. The protected Quest Log draw path is unchanged. Focused QuestLog/QuestFrame and full interface suites pass.
